name: read_interpolation_metadata

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,re,subprocess,sys
L=pathlib.Path.cwd();s=(L/'sources/matching-metadata.html').read_text();print('CHALLENGE',[(x,s.lower().find(x)) for x in ['challenge-platform','cf-chl-','incapsula','verify you are human']]);print('\n'.join(x for x in s.splitlines() if any(w in x.lower() for w in ['doi','journal-ref','submission-history','v1','v2','v3'])))
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/interpolation.pdf','-'],text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'sources/interpolation.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert p.returncode==0
print(r.stdout[:29000]);print('TOTAL',len(r.stdout))
print('EI_CONCLUSION', (L/'sources/eicycle.txt').read_text()[-9000:])
